description: Read live values: logic (one, many, with slots, atmosphere and reagents in one frame), memory, a device snapshot, values over time, the clock, flight logs. Read only.

options.id: logic: Device(s); with logic, every id is read for every logic type. snapshot: Only these devices. memory: One id, or "looking_at" (the thing the crosshair is on). sample: An id, a list, a ref ('r3'), or "looking_at". flight_log: A rocket's id, name, network or any part; left out when there is one rocket. Any what that takes an id takes a list: one row per id, {results: [{index, ok, reference_id, ...} or {index, ok, reference_id, error}], count, success_count, error_count}; a bad id is a row with error.
options.logic: logic: Logic type(s): name (Temperature) or number. snapshot: Logic types; left out, every one. sample:
options.reads: logic: Separate reads, each {id, logic, slots: [{index, logic}], atmosphere: {of, port}, reagents: true}: up to 256 pairs, or 128 per-item reads. sample: Separate {id, logic} pairs.
options.prefab: Prefab: a whole name, a hash, or parts with * ('*Battery*', '*Tank*Insulated*': each part, any order); or a list of them.

logic.summary: logic values of devices, by type name or number; also slot logic, atmosphere and reagents in one frame

id.description: Device(s); with logic, every id is read for every logic type.

reads.x-script: Separate reads, each {id, logic, slots: [{index, logic}], atmosphere: {of, port}, reagents: True}: up to 256 pairs, or 128 per-item reads.

include.description: clock: the game clock in the same frame.

text: One rule for the reply: one id and one logic type answer {reference_id, logic_type {id, name}, value}. id and logic lists, or reads whose every entry is a pair, answer one row per (id, logic) pair, index counting the pairs: results [{index, ok, reference_id, logic_type, value} or {index, ok, reference_id, error}], up to 256. Any entry with a logic list, slots, atmosphere or reagents, or include, answers one row per item in one frame: results [{index, ok, reference_id, logic {Type: value}, logic_errors, slots, atmosphere, reagents, errors} or {index, ok, reference_id, error}], up to 128 items and 1,024 values; more is refused, naming the bound.

The two list forms: id: [a, b], logic: ["On", "Power"] answers 4 rows, one per (id, logic) pair: {index, ok, reference_id, logic_type {id, name}, value}. reads: [{id: a, logic: ["On", "Power"]}, {id: b, logic: ["On", "Power"]}] answers 2 rows, one per id: {index, ok, reference_id, logic {On: 1, Power: 40.2}}.
